overview: Mystery Boxes are miscellaneous items in Miner's Haven, which contain exclusive items the player can obtain at a chance.
They are widely available to the player, obtainable through fallen Research Crates, redeeming codes, daily gifts, and purchasing them from Spook McDooks.

There are 14 variants of the Mystery Box in the game, some catering to specific groups of items. Of the fourteen boxes, six are considered "limited" for their restrictive time window in which a player can freely obtain the box.
The roulette is purely for show as the second you open a box the Item you get from the box appears in your inventory.
clovers: Lucky Clovers are box modifiers that can be earned in a variety of ways, such as through obtaining Research Crates or purchasing them from Spook McDooks (25 uC).

While the clovers don't boost the chances of obtaining rarer items, they do allow for the roller to obtain multiple copies of their winning item. One can have a chance of getting up to 2 or 3 of the same item from boxes with lucky clovers. This applies to items of any tier, including Vintages, Exotics and Relics. If the player wishes not to use up their clovers, it can be toggled on/off from the box opening UI. Red-Banded Boxes are always lucky.

unrigged: Un-Rigged Boxes were boxes introduced in Part 2 of the 2017 Summer Update. These boxes have a chance of appearing when opening an Inferno, Magnificent, or an Unreal Box. They're meant to troll the user by "un-rigging" the box. These boxes cycle through all the vintages and exotics, then land on something the user probably didn't want (i.e., Unobtanium Mine surrounded by vintages). You had a chance to obtain vintages/exotics, but it is extremely rare from these boxes. These boxes were added under the running gag of users complaining of bad luck from Mystery Boxes, claiming that they were rigged.
These boxes were subsequently patched out of the game in the Resurrection Update.
twitch: Twitch Coins were first announced by Berezaa on May 18th, 2016, demoed in a Twitch stream on May 20th, 2016, and released the first two codes, which provided Twitch Coins, on stream. Twitch Coins, when used, give a chance of giving the 5 exclusive Twitch items. Due to Berezaa's lack of streaming and his request, Twitch Coins were officially discontinued and converted into Twitch Boxes.

trivia: The Exotic highlight color has undergone multiple changes. In its initial introduction during Halloween 2015 it was purple, then in the following Spring of 2016, it was changed to orange. It was later changed to sky blue in the Outdoors Update, and it has remained that color since.
Before the April 2016 Updates, Mystery Boxes originally costed uC to open. Regular Boxes cost 5 to open, while Unreal and Inferno Boxes cost 10 to open.

The line "Inferno Boxes: No longer rigged" appears in the 2017 Summer Update Mini-Patch and Part 2 changelogs over at bergames.com. This is due to the Rigged Inferno Boxes running gag where players would complain about bad luck from Inferno (and other) boxes.
Before 28 April 2018, Contraband-tier items were seen/obtainable in other boxes than Red-Banded Boxes.
The Cake-Raffle Box is the only box that doesn't contain any Vintage-tier items.
If you die while opening a Mystery Box or die while having the box UI open, the background blur is removed.
